title: Boyhood injuries: the bat and the sled
summary: Hit in the mouth by his sister Louise's bat, and a sled crash into a boulder in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That's pretty hard to deal with. And I might say that incidentally I had an incident happen to me during that period of early childhood when the family was playing ball, and another one of my sisters, Louise -- we were playing ball and I was catching, and on her back swing she
hit me in the mouth with the bat. So if I show any signs of being slightly afflicted with insanity, of some sort, you can understand I've had several instances -- incidents that happened to cause it.

Also, in Chicago, one of the many places where my father was minister, I remember sliding down a hill on a sled and hitting a boulder with my head, stopping the sled and me and everything with the boulder in my head, you know.
I think that the thorough examination of my brain might bring some revelations of importance.
